name: Standing Order Return Criteria 1
definition: Defines the criteria used to report on standing orders.

StandingOrderIdentificationIndicator.name: Standing Order Identification Indicator
StandingOrderIdentificationIndicator.definition: Defines the criteria used to report on a multilateral balance.

TypeIndicator.name: Type Indicator
TypeIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the standing order type is requested.

SystemMemberIndicator.name: System Member Indicator
SystemMemberIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the system member identification is requested.

ResponsiblePartyIndicator.name: Responsible Party Indicator
ResponsiblePartyIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the responsible party identification is requested.

CurrencyIndicator.name: Currency Indicator
CurrencyIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the account currency is requested.

DebtorAccountIndicator.name: Debtor Account Indicator
DebtorAccountIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the account type is requested.

CreditorAccountIndicator.name: Creditor Account Indicator
CreditorAccountIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the multilateral limit is requested.

AssociatedPoolAccount.name: Associated Pool Account
AssociatedPoolAccount.definition: Indicates whether the associated pool account is requested.

FrequencyIndicator.name: Frequency Indicator
FrequencyIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the frequency is requested.

ExecutionTypeIndicator.name: Execution Type Indicator
ExecutionTypeIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the execution type is requested.

ValidityFromIndicator.name: Validity From Indicator
ValidityFromIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the account standing order is requested.

ValidToIndicator.name: Valid To Indicator
ValidToIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the account owner information is requested.

LinkSetIdentificationIndicator.name: Link Set Identification Indicator
LinkSetIdentificationIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the link set identification is requested.

LinkSetOrderIdentificationIndicator.name: Link Set Order Identification Indicator
LinkSetOrderIdentificationIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the identification of a standing order within a link set is requested.

LinkSetOrderSequenceIndicator.name: Link Set Order Sequence Indicator
LinkSetOrderSequenceIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the sequence of a standing order within a link set is requested.

TotalAmountIndicator.name: Total Amount Indicator
TotalAmountIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the total amount per standing order type is requested.

ZeroSweepIndicator.name: Zero Sweep Indicator
ZeroSweepIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the zero sweeping indicator is requested.
